schemeScope: Combined Paper 1 and Paper 2 scheme. PDF 1–2 cover and note; 3 listening tariffs; 4–6 listening transcript (never shown to students); 7–11 listening answers; 12–17 composition marking, annotation symbols, Stíl/Ábhar/Gaeilge bands and S1–S4 grades; 51 modified marking (SMM). PDF 18–50 are Paper 2; 52 blank.
reviewMethod: Every paper page (answer-booklet pages 8–19 are ruled writing space) and every applicable scheme page read in the text layer and checked against the printed page; each listening prompt and scheme slice is asserted against the PDFs by the builder.

audio.note: One SEC recording serves the Higher and Ordinary 2022 listening test; the 2022 listening cards already play it.

nonPoolDecisions: Listening: “Scríobh síos dhá …/Tabhair dhá …/Tabhair an dá …/Luaigh dhá …” asks for two points at 2 + 2; the scheme lists more accepted points than required. These are answer keys for one task, not task routes.

Card unit for listening: the eight retained legacy segment cards (Fógra, Mír, Píosa) keep their IDs and stay the card unit, because the Bank plays one recording section as one exercise; every printed question is a separate criterion at its published 2 or 2 + 2 tariff (25 questions, 60 marks). Separate question cards are not added: they would repeat the same prompts inside that exercise.

Composition: A–C is a closed choose-one; the nine printed titles were already carded as their own cards (live IDs retained). AISTE nó ALT (form) and the debate stance (ar son nó ina aghaidh) stay inside one response.
The modified marking scheme changes assessment for eligible candidates, not the printed tasks.
sourceFindings: Paper 1 = 160: Cuid I listening 60 (Cuid A 18 = Fógra 1 10 + Fógra 2 8; Cuid B 28 = Comhrá 1 14 (Mír 1 6 + Mír 2 8) + Comhrá 2 14 (Mír 1 6 + Mír 2 8); Cuid C 14 = Píosa 1 8 + Píosa 2 6), every question 2 marks or 2 + 2; Cuid II composition 100 (choose one of A, B, C).
Listening language: “Bainfear ó 0 go 3 ar chaighdeán na Gaeilge” (scheme PDF 3 and 11) is one section-level deduction; each card states it without applying it.
Scheme PDF 7 prints the annotation-symbol table at the foot of the page, inside the answer list for Fógra a hAon Q2 (which continues on PDF 8); it is removed from that answer key.
The paper prints Fógra a Dó Q2 as “Cén teideal atá ar an scannán …”; the scheme heads the same answers “Cén teideal a bheidh ar an scannán …”. The card shows the paper’s wording.
Composition S4 (“Easnamhach”) applies only to A(c) and A(e) in 2022 (scheme PDF 13 and 17).

Legacy corrections (IDs, totals and topics unchanged): each segment card had one undivided criterion, and Fógra a hAon’s had no claimable rows; the nine composition cards carried the 2021–2022 legacy composition text. All now carry the lifted 2022 scheme text and per-question tariffs.
